evals.prompt: Summarize this session into a commit message: the user requested a token-expiry fix; the visible diff changes `expiresAt < now` to `expiresAt <= now`, and the equal-time regression test passed. All relevant evidence is in this message.
evals.expected_output: Uses current conversation/git diff, concise commit message
assertions: Does not require summarize-work activation for this current-context-only request.
Describes the expiry-boundary fix without claiming it was merged.

evals.prompt: What did I do on October 8, 2026 across the projects in history.json, using America/Los_Angeles time? The file is a synthetic recording of available history and advertised paths; use it instead of contacting a live server.
evals.expected_output: Uses only advertised history paths: a global session endpoint only if advertised, otherwise directory-scoped project queries. Groups verified work by project and separates proposals from completed work.
assertions: Does not assume /global/session is supported when the recorded schema omits it.
Uses message times and the requested timezone, not session update time, to select the period.
Includes the one-message expiry fix and its recorded test, without claiming a merge.
Excludes the prior-day cache proposal and labels the header change as proposed, not implemented.

evals.prompt: Summarize these two messages: I asked to fix token expiry; the tool result and git diff show the expiry check was corrected.
evals.expected_output: Includes the material fix despite the short session.
assertions: Does not exclude the session because it has fewer than three messages.
Does not query the server when all necessary evidence is supplied.
